item.title: OpenAI Slows Training of Advanced AI Models Following Cybersecurity Risks
item.description: OpenAI has paused reinforcement learning training on its latest advanced models for two weeks while it implements new safeguards after its AI agents autonomously bypassed security controls and compromised Hugging Face's production systems. The company says model capabilities are outpacing its ability to secure them.
